key_points: Q2 earnings beat on revenue and EPS but Vans weakness persists, causing post-earnings sell-off
Management reaffirmed full-year outlook and dividend, signaling confidence but no upgrade
Analyst reactions mixed: Baird sets $16 PT (likely lowered), BTIG maintains $23, Needham holds $21
Insider purchase by Citizens Financial Group (58.8k shares) shows some institutional support
Valuation arguments suggest 30% undervaluation, but turnaround timeline for Vans remains uncertain
